pr_body:
This PR is a workaround for the bug (inability to check remote indices' privileges via `_has_privileges` API, see https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/67798 for more details).
It skips all the remote indices when doing `_has_privileges` check on datafeed and DFA PUT.

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/87832
pr_title: [ML] Skip remote clusters when performing up front privileges validation
